hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */details/*.md|*/conversations/*.md) d=$(dirname "$f"); git -C "$d" add "$f" && git -C "$d" commit -m "Auto-commit: $(basename "$f")" -- "$f" && git -C "$d" push origin HEAD && git -C "$d" push origin HEAD:main;; esac >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
